role: The vanilla plugin-channel packet (channel name up to 20 chars plus a byte payload). Vanilla's only client-to-server use is MC|TrSel, the villager trade selection; book editing uses MC|BEdit/MC|BSign.
scope_reason: In scope: selecting another trade in a villager's window sends MC|TrSel (GuiMerchant.actionPerformed; NetHandlerPlayServer.processVanilla250Packet sets the merchant container's recipe index), which trade-s1 exercises. Only the book channels (book_editing = off), MC|ItemName (anvil = off), MC|Beacon (beacon = off) and MC|AdvCdm (command blocks cannot be obtained) are unreachable.

members.name: field_149562_a (channel)
members.note: the only channel modelled is MC|TrSel (client_out trsel_window/trsel_index/has_trsel)

members.name: field_149561_c (payload)
members.note: the payload's one recipe index is trsel_index

members.name: C17PacketCustomPayload
members.note: GuiMerchant.actionPerformed's own index change and its C17 ride the act's ["trsel"] op, which builds the packet with this ctor as GuiMerchant does (the payload is the buffer's whole backing array; the server reads its first int); trade-s1, trade-full-s1 and trade-prof-s1 run it

members.name: readPacketData
members.note: wire framing; the native engine has no network

members.name: processPacket
members.note: the MC|TrSel handler: NetHandlerPlayServer's setCurrentRecipeIndex on the open merchant container, gated on window id

members.name: C17PacketCustomPayload
members.note: the decoder's ctor only: Packet.generatePacket instantiates it by reflection (newInstance) for bytes read off a socket (MessageDeserializer); the integrated server's local channel passes packet objects with no codec (NetworkManager.provideLocalClient adds only the packet_handler), so it never runs

notes: The container_merchant_set_recipe_index citation appears under both survival.c (call site) and container.c (implementation); the implementation is container.c:1060. idxaudit 2026-09-27: was switched_off/not_applicable; the scope reason did not hold (DEVLOG 2026-09-27, lane/idxaudit). lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records trade-full-s1, whose native replay starts before the behaviour. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the client's trsel op never set client_out.has_trsel, so the server never ran MC|TrSel; fixed in survival.c surv_client_input, and trade-full-s1 (row 149's trsel and the sound draw of its reset) and trade-prof-s1 (four selections of offer 1) replay exactly.
